title: Reading strategy for a dense architecture manual
authority: derived from manual preface and contents
summary: Use the manual as a reference graph: concepts often appear before their detailed definition.
rules: distinguish architecture definition from model availability
treat page numbers as printed chapter pages, not PDF viewer indices
read storage and control before DAT or interruption details
look up instruction format before instruction semantics
use appendixes for cross-checks, not as substitutes for the main definition
